Why should you enable MFA for your Zoho accounts?

A single stolen password is enough to expose multiple employee accounts and company resources. Another step of verification is thus a necessity. Compromised passwords should not automatically mean account takeovers.

Do it with MFA — Protect your work accounts from credential-based attacks

Authenticator-based MFA utilizes time-based OTPs generated on an external device, which attackers don't control, reducing credential-based attacks by up to 99%.

Frequently
asked questions
Why should I use an authenticator app instead of SMS-based login?
 

Implementing 2FA with authenticator apps like Zoho OneAuth provides greater security during login as it involves an external device. Unlike SMS OTPs based login, this kind of authentication ensures accounts are free from SIM swap attacks, SMS-based phishing, and more.

What is a passphrase and why is it important?
 

A passphrase is a set of characters used to speed up the recovery process and help regain access to your Zoho OneAuth account in case of device loss, formatting, or app uninstallation.

Passphrase also helps sync your OTP codes across devices and use the account across devices.

Is Zoho OneAuth free to use?
 

Yes. Zoho OneAuth is available for free across platforms and can be used to enable MFA for Zoho work accounts as well as secure personal online accounts.
